English: Prayer Stand
A simple wooden stand for prayer, marking a communal place for worship on the open steppe.
Carved Post
A decorated post engraved with holy verses, serving as a rallying point for the faithful and a marker of unity.
Stone Minbar
A simple stone pulpit from which sermons and decrees are delivered, fostering religious discipline.
Small Minaret
A humble minaret of timber and earth, from which the call to prayer resounds across the steppe.
Timber Minaret
A sturdy minaret of fine timber, standing as a symbol of piety and communal identity.
Walled Minaret
The minaret is now protected by a low stone wall, solidifying its place at the heart of the camp and attracting respected scholars.
High Minaret
A tall, impressive minaret visible from great distance, drawing travelers and uniting clans in faith.
Decorated Minaret
A beautifully adorned minaret inlaid with intricate patterns, becoming a center of pilgrimage and learning.
Sanctified Minaret
A minaret recognized as a holy site, inspiring the faithful and binding clans in religious unity.
Grand Arabic Minaret
A towering, legendary minaret of marble and gold, renowned across the steppes and revered by all clans for its sanctity.
